title: Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Transaction Filter Endpoint
description: The 'sort' query parameter is concatenated directly into an SQL ORDER BY clause without parameterization, allowing full database extraction.
impact: An unauthenticated attacker can read sensitive financial records, user password hashes, and modify transaction logs.
steps_to_reproduce: Inject boolean payload into the sort parameter using CASE WHEN syntax
Observe deterministic response differences confirming blind SQL injection
raw_http_request:
GET /v1/transactions/search?sort=id&api_key=sk_live_9988776655 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.acmefintech.local
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.secretpayload
Cookie: session_id=xyz987654321; theme=dark
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0

title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on Invoice PDF Download & Modification
description: The invoice endpoint verifies that the user is logged in, but fails to verify whether invoice ID 10492 belongs to the authenticated user session.
impact: Any authenticated user can enumerate sequential invoice IDs, download confidential billing PDFs, and overwrite payout details of other customers.
steps_to_reproduce: Log in as User A (user_id: 501) and capture the request to download invoice 10491.
Replay the request in Burp Repeater while changing the path ID to 10492 (owned by User B).
Observe that the server returns HTTP 200 OK with User B's confidential PDF invoice.
raw_http_request:
GET /api/v2/invoices/10492/download HTTP/1.1
Host: app.acmefintech.local
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.userAtoken
Cookie: auth_sid=ab12cd34ef56

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Merchant Dispute Comment
description: User comments inside transaction dispute threads are rendered using unsafe innerHTML without HTML entity encoding.
impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser context of support agents or other merchants viewing the dispute.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to an active dispute thread.
Submit a comment containing a benign SVG onload proof-of-concept payload.
Reload the page and observe script execution in the DOM.
raw_http_request:
POST /disputes/comment HTTP/1.1
Host: app.acmefintech.local
Cookie: session=my_secret_session_value
Content-Type: application/json

{"dispute_id": 88, "comment": "<svg/onload=alert(document.domain)>", "secret": "my_hidden_key"}

title: Verbose Server Version Banner Disclosure on Marketing Blog
description: The blog server exposes minor version headers in REST API responses.
impact: Low risk; assists attackers in fingerprinting software versions (Note: Target is Out-of-Scope).
steps_to_reproduce: Send a HEAD request to https://blog.acmefintech.local/wp-json
Inspect the Server and X-Powered-By response headers.
